description: Essays, a field guide and research notes on application security, identity and agent identity. Every capability is read-only and public: no sign-in, no approval, nothing is changed.

capabilities.description: Full-text search over essays, field-guide entries, talks, projects, the glossary and the profile page, optionally by kind or topic. Returns titles, canonical URLs and the best matching section.
Full Markdown of one entry with front matter (dates, review status, license), by catalog id such as jb-jwks or canonical URL.
Quotable findings with their anchor URL, source and review status, filtered by entry id or words.
The site's six topics with descriptions, URLs and entry counts.
Markdown version of any page: GET its URL plus index.md, or the page URL with Accept: text/markdown.
GET /catalog.json: ids, canonical URLs, publication, modification and review dates, topics, license and content hash for every entry.
GET /findings.json: every quotable finding with its anchor URL, source and review status.
GET /search/index.json: the full-text index the MCP search runs on, for searching client-side.
